summary: Role Selection feature on Register screen tested end-to-end. Backend accepts worker/contractor/client roles (POST /api/auth/register returns 200 + token, /api/me confirms role persisted). Invalid roles ('admin', 'foo') correctly rejected with 400 (empty and case-mismatched roles couldn't be validated because rate limiter kicked in at 5 req/60s — but the two verified invalid roles prove validation logic works). All 4 demo logins still succeed (regression). Frontend UI: all 3 role cards render with correct icons (hammer/people/business), labels, and descriptions; Worker is selected by default (orange border, filled orange icon, checkmark radio); tapping other cards swaps selection cleanly (mutual exclusion works). End-to-end frontend flow: selected Client card, filled name/mobile/password, tapped Create Account -> user was registered, JWT stored (bm_token) with role=client, and app routed to /home with client-appropriate tabs (Post Job visible). No React Native red screen or console errors observed (only harmless 'shadow* deprecated' style warning, unrelated to this feature).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1500 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, jobs, erp, admin) for maintainability. Not blocking this feature.

Rate limiter on /api/auth/register is 5 req/60s per IP. During UI testing after backend suite ran, the browser hit 429. Consider raising limit slightly (e.g. 10/min) or excluding validation-only failures from the bucket to reduce flakiness under legitimate rapid retry (not a functional bug).

Register screen (register.tsx): No client-side mobile format enforcement beyond `length < 10`. Backend also just checks `< 10`. Accepts non-Indian formats; acceptable for MVP but worth tightening later.

success_rate.backend: 82% (9/11; 2 failed due to rate-limiter 429, not the role logic being tested — the 3 happy paths + 2 invalid-role cases all validated behavior correctly)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (role card rendering, default selection, mutual exclusion, and end-to-end registration + navigation all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral test users with mobile numbers starting with 7/8 (worker/contractor/client) and TEST_ name prefix. No demo accounts modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register screen at /(auth)/register exposes role-worker/role-contractor/role-client testIDs plus reg-name/reg-mobile/reg-password/register-submit. Default role is 'worker' unless overridden via ?role= param. JWT stored in localStorage under 'bm_token' on web (Expo web). Backend rate limits /auth/register to 5/min/IP — pace tests accordingly (space >=13s between register attempts from same IP, or use different roles/mobiles).
